headings: [Salesforce Overall](rn_general.md "Learn about new features and enhancements that affect your Salesforce experience overall.")
[Agentforce](rn_einstein.md "Supercharge your workforce efficiency with predictive and generative AI.")

[Analytics](rn_analytics.md "Analytics enhancements include new and updated features for Tableau Next, Lightning reports and dashboards, Data 360 reports and dashboards, CRM Analytics, Intelligent apps, and Tableau.")

[Automation](rn_automate.md "Compose intelligent workflows with Flow Builder and Flow Orchestration. Integrate across any system with Flow Integration. Get help from AI to optimize and automate your supply chain business processes with Agentforce Supply Chain. Automate cross-departmental and industry-specific processes with Automation for Customer 360 Apps and Industries.")
[Commerce](rn_commerce.md "Commerce enhancements can include features for B2C Commerce, B2B Commerce, Omnichannel Inventory, Order Management, Salesforce Payments, and Point of Sale.")

[Customization](rn_customization.md "More granular list view permissions let users share their list views without giving them the ability to edit all of your org's list views. Help your users stay synchronized, thanks to support for 27 more canonical time zones in accordance with IANA standards. Get more robust and secure authentication with the Salesforce Connect cross-org adapter's support for named credentials.")

[Data 360](rn_c360_truth.md "Data 360 features and changes are released as often as monthly, so check back again soon for the latest solutions. Changes included in the Summer ’26 release are generally listed under June 2026.")
[Deployment](rn_deployment.md "Whether you’re an admin using point-and-click tools or a developer writing code, these enhancements help you deploy your changes to a target org.")

[Development](rn_development.md "Whether you’re using Lightning components, Visualforce, Apex, or Salesforce APIs with your favorite programming language, these enhancements help you develop amazing applications, integrations, and packages for resale to other organizations.")

[Experience Cloud](rn_experiences.md "Malware scans for Salesforce Files are now generally available. Upload files as large as 10 GB to an Aura or LWR site. Use a suite of AI-assisted Self-Service components in your Aura or Lightning Web Runtime site to deliver personalized self-service experiences. Enable people who use public email services to send email from your site. Turn on Chatter in new orgs to add or access Chatter-dependent features in Aura and LWR sites.")
[Field Service](rn_fieldservice.md "Learn about the latest features and updates to supercharge team productivity and operations in and out of the field.")

[Hyperforce](rn_hyperforce.md "Salesforce Advanced Cross-Region Continuity is now available in the EU, with faster recovery times in all available regions. Salesforce B2C Commerce is available on Hyperforce in the US. Several products are newly available for Government Cloud Defense.")
[Industries](rn_industries.md "Learn about new features and enhancements across the Industries clouds.")

[Marketing](rn_marketing_parent.md "Personalize every moment of engagement across the customer lifecycle and drive growth for your business with the latest marketing features and enhancements from Salesforce.")

[MuleSoft](rn_mulesoft.md "Use the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform suite of products to connect and integrate apps, systems, and data across your enterprise. Streamline operations by building and automating processes with clicks instead of code.")

[Mobile](rn_mobile.md "Agentforce Voice is now generally available for integration in your mobile apps with the Agentforce Mobile SDK. The Salesforce mobile app now supports AI-powered meeting transcriptions. Enjoy improved project management in Mobile Publisher.")

[Partner Cloud](rn_partner_cloud.md "Accelerate business growth by expanding partner connectivity and advancing data transparency through secure record sharing and synchronization. Deliver consistent customer experiences by using brand-compliant marketing content directly within Experience Cloud sites.")
[Revenue Management](rn_revenue.md "Learn about new features and enhancements for Agentforce Revenue Management.")

[Sales](rn_sales.md "Sales Cloud is now Agentforce Sales. You may see references to Sales Cloud in Salesforce applications and documentation. Learn about the latest features and updates to supercharge sales team productivity and operations. The Summer ’26 release includes updates and announcements happening from May through August 2026.")

[Salesforce CMS](rn_cms.md "The CMS Base data kit is now generally available, and you can deploy it more easily from a simplified setup page. Deploy the data kit to support features such as semantic and AI-powered search for content. Developers can use the new Managed Content GraphQL API to search for CMS content.")

[Salesforce for Slack Integrations](rn_slack_apps.md "Beginning in Summer ’26, Salesforce channels are available by default in new orgs in Enterprise and Unlimited editions. Use the new Slack panel on record pages in Salesforce for a more streamlined user experience with Salesforce channels.")

[Security, Identity, and Privacy](rn_security.md "Prepare for new and upcoming security enhancements. Restore data more effectively and gain control over backup operations. Ensure your integrations stay connected by switching to unique, branded web addresses. Meet standard regulations with AI-driven insights.")
[Service](rn_service.md "Learn about the latest features and updates to supercharge support team productivity and operations.")
